candidate.summary: Quotes the Jikji imprint, dated Xuanguang 7 (1377), reading 'printed with movable metal type at Heungdeoksa Temple outside Cheongju'; states that the only extant movable metal type print is the second volume of Jikji, held at the BnF, and that the woodblock edition (1378) survives complete.
